FN-8B4P2F2-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 63
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/09/2024
Senate Bill 63 as introduced could decrease future potential obligations of county
commissions, in the form of reimbursements for litigation costs and damages, by limiting the
liability of county commissions regarding the expenditure of public funds.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 63
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/16/2024
Senate Bill 63 as passed the Senate could reduce the potential obligations of county
commissions, for reimbursements of litigation costs and damages regarding the use of public
funds under certain conditions.
